newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka foreign minister to visit India.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka foreign minister to visit India.

text.p: Sri Lankan Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar will visit India for a "couple of days" later this week, foreign ministry sources said.
They said Kadirgamar would meet the new Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral and other officials.
Sri Lanka has welcomed Gujral's appointment as prime minister, calling him an old friend who will further strengthen ties between the two neighbours.

Indo-Sri Lanka relations touched a low in the late 1980s after Indian troops arrived in the island to disarm rebels of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) under a controversial agreement between the two countries.
But ties have improved dramatically since President Chandrika Kumaratunga's People's Alliance took power in 1994.
